interest: I want to know whether a residual (skip) path helps a shallow MLP image classifier on a small dataset because of the path itself, or only because the variant has more parameters or trains differently.
hunches: On a network this shallow the residual path adds little once parameter count and training steps are matched.
avoid: Pure hyperparameter sweeps with no mechanism behind them
contribution: A two-arm comparison with a parameter-matched control; a clean negative result is welcome.
known: A logistic-regression baseline reaches about 3.8% error on this split
